messages:
tara_solutions: Quick sync — AcmeCorp PoV: we need staging cutover dates, who owns the demo deck handoff, and final success criteria. planning to ramp traffic next Wed-Fri.

james_amato: Thanks — sales will own customer comms. can we lock staging ready by Tue EOD? i put a tentative date in the calendar.

ryan_eng: I can own staging infra. blockers: we need a static IP for their webhook and a cert rotation window. pinged infra.

maria_infra: On the IP/cert — i can reserve the IP today. cert rotation slot: Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC (low traffic). ok?

tara_solutions: Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC works. @ryan_eng can you confirm the deployment checklist? small frag: model variant for PoV should be quantized-x4.

ryan_eng: confirmed. deployment checklist (short):
```
- namespace: acme-pov-staging
- model: redwood/rw-pv-3b-q4
- batcher: adaptive, max_tokens=512
- prefix_cache: enabled
- ingress: static-ip + cert (maria to attach)
```

ryan_eng: i'll open a PR with terraform + k8s manifests today. expecting 2 code reviews.

olivia_cs: i'll prepare the demo script and success rubric. quick Q — Are we validating throughput at 50 rps or 100 rps?

james_amato: customer asked for 50 rps sustained with 200ms P50 and <500ms P95. make that our bar.

tara_solutions: noted. success criteria: 1) 50 rps sustained for 10m with P95 < 500ms; 2) embeddings parity test < 0.02 drop in cosine similarity; 3) demo deck + runbook handed off to CS.

olivia_cs: will have the deck draft by Tue noon. need sample prompts from solutions.

tara_solutions: dropping the prompt set in this thread in a sec. also attaching the acceptance checklist in the runbook PR.

deploy_bot: Deployment scheduled: staging/app-acme-pov at 2026-04-14T02:15:00Z — terraform plan succeeded.

maria_infra: IP reserved: 34.82.199.12. cert rotation slot confirmed.

ryan_eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/742 — contains manifests + runbook link. requesting review from @maria_infra and @tara_solutions.

tara_solutions: thanks. i'll review PR tonight and prep prompts. james, can you confirm customer demo attendees?

james_amato: yes — PM + Eng manager + Sec lead. sending calendar invite now. :thumbsup:

olivia_cs: ack — will sync with demo attendees and build the slide deck around the rubric.

tara_solutions: great. next milestone: PR merged + staging smoke tests green by Tue 18:00 UTC. i'll follow up if anything slips.

james_amato: flagging one dependency — their SRE needs port 9001 opened inbound. @ryan_eng / @maria_infra can you confirm firewall rule?

maria_infra: can do. i'll add firewall rule after IP is attached.

ryan_eng: i'll add port to ingress security group in the PR.

tara_solutions: perfect. thanks everyone — i'll update the PoV tracker and ping again if anything else pops up. :raised_hands:
